papers.title: LogT: Logically Think with Images for Visual Search
papers.abstract: Thinking with images empowers vision-language models (VLMs) to use an external Zoom-in tool for fine-grained visual search. Recent works employ supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) with tool-specific designs to enable such capabilities. However, achieving logical reasoning alongside accurate and efficient tool use remains a significant challenge. To address this, we shift the focus away from increasing RL complexity and instead identify SFT data quality as a key bottleneck. We then propose LogT (short for Logically Think with Images), a fully automated SFT data engine that explicitly enforces logic-chain-guided reasoning. LogT generates an SFT dataset featuring challenging, visually grounded questions and structured tool-use traces with human-like logic. We validate our approach by fine-tuning two base models, Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL3.5-8B, on the dataset and evaluating them across seven benchmark test sets. We show that LogT-SFT based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B outperforms the state-of-the-art trained with both SFT and RL, despite using 3.1$\times$ less data and $>120\times$ fewer GPU hours. Furthermore, applying a simple RL recipe without tool-specific design on LogT-SFT yields a model that surpasses prior methods with complex RL setups by a substantial 9.59-point margin. In addition to strong performance gains, our model exhibits higher tool-use accuracy and efficiency, as well as more structured and logically consistent reasoning traces, directly validating the effectiveness of our approach.

ai_summary.problem: 该论文旨在解决视觉语言模型在使用外部Zoom-in工具进行细粒度视觉搜索时，难以同时实现逻辑推理与准确、高效工具调用的问题。
ai_summary.method: 作者将瓶颈归因于SFT数据质量，提出全自动SFT数据引擎LogT，显式强制逻辑链引导推理，生成包含挑战性视觉 grounding 问题和类人逻辑工具使用轨迹的数据集，并在Qwen2.5-VL-7B与InternVL3.5-8B上微调验证。
ai_summary.result: 基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B的LogT-SFT以少3.1倍数据和超过120倍更少GPU小时超越SFT+RL的SOTA；简单RL配方进一步带来9.59点显著提升，并展现更高工具使用准确率、效率和更一致的推理轨迹。
ai_summary.novelty: 创新点在于从提升RL复杂度转向提升SFT数据质量，提出自动生成逻辑链引导工具使用轨迹的数据引擎。
ai_summary.relevance: 为工具增强型VLM的视觉搜索提供了一条高效的数据中心化路线，表明高质量逻辑化SFT数据可显著降低训练成本并提升推理与工具使用能力。

papers.title: Self-Calibrating Vision-Agent-Action: Deploying Pick-and-Place to New Robot Cells without Demonstrations or Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract: In simulation, Vision-Agent-Action (VAA) performs pick-and-place in robot cells with gripper or base-frame changes without robot demonstrations or fine-tuning. It uses pre-trained vision-language and language models for interpretation, measures the command map and camera geometry from its own motion and fingertips, estimates lens distortion, and plans grasps from measured object depth. A controlled study of eight public LIBERO-fine-tuned vision-language-action models (VLAs) varies robot hardware, camera geometry, appearance, and base frame. Gripper and frame changes dominate their losses in the tested fractional design. Across 18 cells with these changes, frozen VAA achieves 230/360 successes (64%), the refined VAA 268/360 (74%), and the strongest released VLA on this subset 76/360 (21%). Paired ablations support the self-calibration bundle, lens estimation under compounded changes, and the measured-depth pipeline. On a two-step LIBERO-Goal chain with object state carried between instructions, VAA completes 54/60 chains in changed cells, while four evaluated VLAs complete none.

ai_summary.problem: 论文要解决视觉-智能体-动作（VAA）系统在机器人硬件、相机几何、外观和基座坐标系变化时性能严重下降的问题，目标是无需机器人演示和微调即可将抓取放置任务部署到新的机器人单元。
ai_summary.method: 提出自校准的 Vision-Agent-Action 框架，利用预训练视觉语言模型和语言模型进行理解，并通过机器人自身运动和指尖测量命令映射与相机几何、估计镜头畸变，再基于测量得到的物体深度规划抓取。
ai_summary.result: 在18个存在硬件与坐标系变化的机器人单元中，冻结VAA达到230/360成功率（64%），改进版达到268/360（74%），而最强公开VLA仅76/360（21%）；在两步骤LIBERO-Goal链式任务中VAA完成54/60，四个评测VLA均未完成。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是无需演示或微调的自校准机制，使VAA能自主测量并适应新的机器人单元、相机几何和镜头畸变。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作展示了预训练基础模型结合自校准在具身智能跨机器人单元泛化中的潜力，对降低机器人部署成本和提高VLA鲁棒性具有重要意义。

papers.title: Isolating Perception for Multi-View Planning under Occlusion-Induced Partial Observability
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are beginning to saturate visual planning benchmarks, yet they fail to resolve depth ambiguity and degrade sharply with problem size under occlusion-induced partial observability (PO). We introduce BW-PO based on the Blocksworld domain, a controlled benchmark that reduces existing VLM planners and formalizers to near-zero performance, and propose VLM-as-perceiver, a paradigm that narrows the VLM's role to local perception while delegating cross-view evidence reconciliation and plan generation to external solvers. Across model-specific challenging subsets of BW-PO, this raises plan success from 1% to 97% for Gemma-4-31B, 0% to 95% for Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, and 3% to 84% for Gemini-3.1-Pro. Isolating perception in this way separates two bottlenecks that are otherwise entangled: reconciliation under depth ambiguity, and completeness of visual extraction under scene density.

ai_summary.problem: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在遮挡导致的部分可观测场景下进行多视角规划时，难以解决深度歧义，并且性能会随问题规模增大而急剧下降。论文希望系统性地诊断并缓解这一失败。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出基于 Blocksworld 的受控基准 BW-PO，使现有 VLM 规划器和形式化器性能接近零；同时提出 VLM-as-perceiver 范式，把 VLM 的角色限制为局部感知，将跨视角证据对齐与规划生成交给外部求解器。
ai_summary.result: 在 BW-PO 的模型特定困难子集上，该方法将规划成功率从 1% 提升到 97%（Gemma-4-31B）、从 0% 提升到 95%（Qwen3.5-122B-A10B）、从 3% 提升到 84%（Gemini-3.1-Pro）。
ai_summary.novelty: 通过 BW-PO 基准和 VLM-as-perceiver 范式，将 VLM 的感知能力与跨视角证据整合、规划推理分离，从而隔离并分析部分可观测多视角规划中的关键瓶颈。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作表明，将 VLM 限定为感知模块、再与外部求解器结合，可显著提升复杂视觉规划鲁棒性，并为多模态 Agent 与世界模型中的感知-推理分工提供重要实验依据。

papers.title: DecoEdit: Beyond Flat Control for 3D-Aware Unified Image Editing
papers.abstract: While recent advances in multimodal image editing have achieved impressive results, current frameworks remain largely confined to ``flat" 2D controls (e.g., text prompts, bounding boxes, or masks). Precise 3D-aware geometric manipulation -- such as coordinating an object's location, physical scale, and 3D orientation while strictly preserving its fine-grained identity -- remains an elusive challenge, typically suffering from severe detail degradation or requiring expensive per-instance fine-tuning. In this paper, we present DecoEdit, an all-in-one image editing framework that goes beyond flat control by seamlessly integrating 1D textual, 2D spatial, and 3D volumetric inputs under a unified architecture. First, to power this unified model, we establish a data curation pipeline and curate a large-scale dataset, namely DecoDataset, containing 1.6 million samples, encompassing diverse multi-dimensional (1D/2D/3D) tasks and their complex compositions. Furthermore, we establish a comprehensive image editing benchmark named DecoBench to systematically evaluate multi-task editing performance. Finally, to address the fundamental trade-off between complex spatial transformations and identity preservation, we propose a novel decoupled pipeline: DecoEdit factorizes the editing process by utilizing structural guidance from SAM-3D to anchor the target geometry, scale, and spatial orientation, while concurrently leveraging a detail-preservation path to lock in high-fidelity textures. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DecoEdit achieves state-of-the-art results. Notably, on the challenging 3D spatial pose and orientation control tasks, DecoEdit significantly outperforms leading closed-source models such as Seedream 5.0 in both geometric accuracy and identity consistency.

ai_summary.problem: 现有统一图像编辑主要局限于文本、框、掩码等2D“平面”控制，难以在严格保持物体细粒度身份的同时精确操控其3D位置、尺度和朝向。
ai_summary.method: 提出DecoEdit统一框架，融合1D文本、2D空间和3D几何输入；构建160万样本的DecoDataset和DecoBench；采用解耦流程，用SAM-3D结构引导锚定目标几何、尺度和空间朝向，并用细节保持路径锁定高保真纹理。
ai_summary.result: 实验取得SOTA结果，在3D空间姿态和朝向控制任务上，几何精度与身份一致性显著优于Seedream 5.0等领先闭源模型。
ai_summary.novelty: 将1D/2D/3D多维控制统一到图像编辑框架，并通过结构引导与细节保持解耦来缓解复杂3D变换与身份保持之间的根本权衡。
ai_summary.relevance: 推动图像编辑从平面2D控制走向3D感知、多模态统一且高保真身份保持的可控编辑。

papers.title: RoboCoEvo: Expanding Robot Capabilities through Agent-Policy Co-Evolution
papers.abstract: Integrating MLLM-based agents with robotic foundation models has attracted increasing attention as a means of enhancing robotic capabilities. However, the improvement of such integrated systems remains largely decoupled across their agent and model components, with advances in one component not necessarily benefiting the other, substantially limiting the capabilities of the combined system. As both MLLMs and robotic foundation models become increasingly capable, fully realizing their combined potential calls for co-evolution, an iterative process in which improvements in agents and robotic foundation models reinforce one another. We propose RoboCoEvo, a failure-guided co-evolution framework that couples the refinement of the agent's explicit and reusable executable knowledge with parameter learning in robotic foundation models, such as vision-language-action (VLA) models. Through a code-as-policy formulation, the agent develops and refines executable failure-detection and recovery programs, generating targeted corrective experience. Post-training consolidates the resulting corrective behaviors into the robotic model's end-to-end policy, improving autonomous task execution. Changes in the updated policy's failure distribution, in turn, guide subsequent revisions to the agent's programs. Experiments on BEHAVIOR-1K, RoboCasa, and RoboTwin demonstrate sustained improvements in autonomous VLA task performance across successive co-evolution rounds.

ai_summary.problem: 基于MLLM的智能体与机器人基础模型各自进步但相互解耦，难以充分发挥组合系统的潜力。
ai_summary.method: 提出RoboCoEvo失败引导的协同进化框架：智能体通过code-as-policy生成并优化可执行失败检测与恢复程序，产生纠正经验；再通过后训练将纠正行为固化到VLA模型中，并用更新后策略的失败分布指导智能体程序迭代。
ai_summary.result: 在BEHAVIOR-1K、RoboCasa和RoboTwin上，多轮协同进化持续提升自主VLA任务性能。
ai_summary.novelty: 将智能体可复用可执行知识与机器人基础模型参数学习闭环耦合，实现失败驱动的智能体-策略协同进化。
ai_summary.relevance: 为具身智能体与机器人基础模型的自提升和闭环进化提供了可扩展的新范式。

papers.title: Nahual: A Sequence Model for Language and Atoms
papers.abstract: Generative models play a rapidly growing role in the design and simulation of molecules. The most widely used applications of generative models are in large language models (LLMs), owing to the natural flexibility of language for specifying and answering queries. However, generalist LLMs do not effectively handle large sets of 3D coordinates, whereas specialist generative models of 3D molecules cannot reach the controllability afforded by language. To bridge these capabilities, we propose Nahual, a decoder-only autoregressive diffusion model for any sequence of text and 3D molecules. To enable expressive autoregression on continuous coordinates, we propose next-token diffusion, whereby a causal transformer denoises each token while attending to the clean tokens before it, without increasing context size. We train Nahual on a curated set of twelve 3D chemistry tasks ranging from microsolvation to molecular conformer search to adsorption on metal surfaces, with associated evaluation metrics and baselines. The result is a single set of end-to-end-trained weights that simultaneously performs all tasks and surpasses state-of-the-art models specialized for crystal structure prediction and property-conditional molecule generation. Our results demonstrate the viability of scaling generalist decoder-only models for native multimodal understanding and generation across language and chemistry. Code is available at https://github.com/the-matter-lab/nahual.

ai_summary.problem: 通用大语言模型难以有效处理大规模三维坐标，而专门的三维分子生成模型又缺乏语言级别的可控性，论文旨在用单一模型统一语言与三维分子（原子）的理解与生成。
ai_summary.method: 提出 Nahual，一个 decoder-only 的自回归扩散模型，可直接对任意“文本 + 三维分子”序列建模；核心创新是 next-token diffusion：因果 Transformer 在每个 token 上做去噪，同时关注之前的干净 token，从而在不增大上下文长度的前提下实现对连续坐标的自回归生成。
ai_summary.result: 在涵盖微溶剂化、构象搜索到金属表面吸附等 12 个三维化学任务上联合训练，单套端到端权重同时完成所有任务，并在晶体结构预测和性质条件分子生成上超过专门的最先进模型。
ai_summary.novelty: 用 next-token diffusion 把连续三维坐标纳入 decoder-only 自回归框架，实现语言与化学的原生多模态统一建模。
ai_summary.relevance: 为通用 decoder-only 模型在语言之外的原生多模态（尤其是三维结构与科学数据）理解与生成提供了可扩展的范式。
ai_summary.org: 多伦多大学 Matter Lab（推测，基于作者与 GitHub 组织 the-matter-lab）

papers.title: Découpage: Directorial Audio-Visual Control for Long Multi-Shot Video Generation
papers.abstract: In cinematic storytelling, sound and visual transitions do not always coincide in lockstep: dialogue frequently bridges across cuts to reveal reactions or introduces new scenes via J- and L-cuts, while deliberate silences pace the scene. Existing audio-visual generative frameworks, however, lack explicit mechanisms to coordinate independent visual and acoustic timing over extended horizons. As narrative duration and shot complexity scale, these systems struggle to maintain long-range dialogue pacing, often hallucinating speech during intended silences or erroneously driving mouth movements on silent listeners. To enable fine-grained cinematic control, we present DECOUPAGE, a screenplay-driven framework for long-form, multi-shot, and multi-character joint audio-video generation. Rather than coupling modality boundaries by default, DECOUPAGE uncouples generation into independently bounded visual and acoustic tracks governed by persistent character identities. DECOUPAGE builds on a joint audio-video diffusion model with dual-schedule temporal cross-attention, incorporating a directorial Lip-sync mechanism that selectively decouples speech conditioning from visual facial dynamics during off-screen dialogue. On multi-shot conversational benchmarks, DECOUPAGE achieves precise control over shot transitions, audio timing, and visibility-aware lip synchronization, directing 15- to 60-second screenplay-driven audio-video generation with multimodal coherence.

ai_summary.problem: 现有音视频生成框架缺乏在长时间跨度上独立协调视觉与声音时序的机制，难以处理跨镜头对话、J/L-cut 以及有意静默等电影化叙事需求，容易在静默段落幻觉语音或让沉默者错误动嘴。
ai_summary.method: 提出 DECOUPAGE，一个剧本驱动的长视频多镜头多角色音视频联合生成框架。它将生成解耦为独立边界的视觉轨与声音轨，由持久角色身份约束，基于联合音视频扩散模型和双调度时间交叉注意力，并引入导演式唇同步机制，在画外对话时选择性将语音条件与面部动态解耦。
ai_summary.result: 在多镜头对话基准上实现了对镜头切换、音频时序和可见性感知唇同步的精确控制，可生成15至60秒、具备多模态连贯性的剧本驱动音视频。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将音视频模态边界显式解耦，并引入导演式选择性唇同步与双调度交叉注意力，实现长时多镜头下声音与视觉时序的独立精细控制。
ai_summary.relevance: 为长时音视频联合生成提供了电影级可控性，推动世界模型与多模态生成在叙事场景中的实用化。

papers.title: Incremental Learning of Vision-Language Models via Task Subspace Projection and Dynamic LoRA
papers.abstract: Recent pre-trained vision-language models often encounter a Multi-Domain Task-Incremental Learning (MTIL) scenario in practice, where a set of classes of multi-modal tasks arrive incrementally. Due to privacy concerns and memory constraints, MTIL with pre-trained models encounters forgetting of knowledge from old tasks, degradation of zero-shot transfer capability, and underfitting of new-task knowledge. To overcome these challenges, previous MTIL methods attempt to learn a discriminative cross-task identification (CTI) module and an effective new-task adaptation (NTA) module. However, current CTI modules suffer from severe task confusion between seen and unseen tasks, and NTA modules cannot adaptively balance the performance and parameter cost while incorporating task-specific knowledge. To alleviate the above dilemmas, we propose an effective and efficient TSP-DLoRA method for MTIL, which consists of Task Subspace Projection (TSP) and Dynamic Low Rank Adapter (DLoRA) modules. Specifically, our TSP module includes a task identifier classifier based on task-specific subspaces and a feature projection strategy that can determine the identifier associated with samples from both seen and unseen tasks. Our DLoRA improves the knowledge adaptation from new tasks by dynamically assigning Low Rank Adapter (LoRA) across transformer layers based on the task distributions. Experimental evaluations across 11 datasets, using three performance metrics, demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method. Code is available at https://github.com/FerdinandZJU/TSP-DLoRA.

ai_summary.problem: 预训练视觉语言模型在多域任务增量学习（MTIL）中会出现旧任务知识遗忘、零样本迁移能力下降以及新任务知识欠拟合的问题。
ai_summary.method: 提出 TSP-DLoRA 方法，包含任务子空间投影（TSP）和动态低秩适配器（DLoRA）：TSP 基于任务特定子空间构建任务识别分类器，并用特征投影判断样本属于已见还是未见任务；DLoRA 根据任务分布动态分配 LoRA 到不同 Transformer 层，以增强新任务知识适配。
ai_summary.result: 在 11 个数据集上用三项指标评估，实验表明该方法在效果和效率上有效。
ai_summary.novelty: 通过任务子空间投影缓解已见/未见任务混淆，并用动态 LoRA 在适配新任务时自适应平衡性能与参数成本。
ai_summary.relevance: 为视觉语言模型的持续学习与多模态增量学习提供了一种有效且高效的解决方案。

papers.title: Omni-Workspace: Benchmarking Omni-Modal AI Assistants on Multimodal Workspace Tasks
papers.abstract: Omni-modal agents are expected to move beyond multimodal understanding toward completing complex tasks in realistic multimodal environments. In these settings, information is distributed across heterogeneous files and modalities, with cross-file and cross-modal dependencies requiring agents to continually coordinate perception, reasoning, and tool use as newly gathered evidence informs subsequent actions. However, existing omni-modal benchmarks primarily focus on multimodal perception and understanding, leaving complex task completion through sustained interaction with multimodal workspaces underexplored. We introduce Omni-Workspace, a benchmark comprising 380 deep-research-style tasks across four multimodal workspace types and two difficulty levels. These tasks require agents to inspect and process workspace files, retrieve external information when needed, integrate evidence across files and modalities, and produce artifacts satisfying explicit requirements. Evaluating 18 representative models reveals limitations in long-horizon multimodal workspace execution, with the best model scoring only 65.93 on average. Further analysis identifies multimodal context inflation and task-state drift as recurring challenges. Motivated by these findings, we further propose OmniFocus, a lightweight approach combining multimodal working-memory management with explicit task-state tracking to improve performance and efficiency. Omni-Workspace advances the evaluation and development of omni-modal agents toward autonomous completion of complex tasks in multimodal workspaces.

ai_summary.problem: 现有全模态基准主要评估多模态感知与理解，缺乏对智能体在真实多模态工作区中通过持续交互完成复杂任务的评测。
ai_summary.method: 提出 Omni-Workspace 基准，包含 380 个深度研究式任务，覆盖四类多模态工作区和两个难度等级，要求智能体检查文件、检索外部信息、跨文件跨模态整合证据并产出满足要求的成果；同时提出轻量方法 OmniFocus，结合多模态工作记忆管理和显式任务状态跟踪。
ai_summary.result: 评估 18 个代表性模型发现长程多模态工作区执行能力有限，最佳模型平均仅得 65.93 分；分析指出多模态上下文膨胀和任务状态漂移是反复出现的挑战，OmniFocus 可提升性能与效率。
ai_summary.novelty: 构建了面向复杂多模态工作区任务完成的全模态智能体基准，并针对长程执行中的上下文膨胀与状态漂移提出轻量缓解方案。
ai_summary.relevance: 推动全模态智能体从多模态理解走向在异构文件与模态环境中自主完成复杂任务，为评测和开发提供新基准与方法参考。

papers.title: WA-JEPA: Goal-Aware Predictive Feedback Action Refinement for a World-Action Model
papers.abstract: JEPA-based world models predict action consequences in latent space, but representative planning approaches rely on candidate-action search, requiring repeated evaluation of action sequences and incurring substantial online computational cost. Direct action generation avoids this search, yet how to leverage latent predictions to guide action generation given task goals remains a key challenge in translating learned physical dynamics into effective decisions. We introduce WA-JEPA, a world-action model that couples action generation, action-conditioned latent prediction, and goal-aware feedback. The model first generates an action proposal and predicts the resulting future scenes and proprioceptive states, then refines the proposal through two complementary feedback paths, using the task goal as a reference. Goal-discrepancy residual feedback (GDRF) uses differences between the latent representations of predicted scenes and the task goal to guide chunk-wise action refinement. Future-scene context feedback (FSCF) preserves fine-grained predicted scene representations to guide subsequent action refinement. Jointly learned from offline demonstrations, this process iteratively updates the same plan before execution, making future predictions directly participate in action generation without candidate-action search. We evaluate short-horizon goal reaching, long-horizon tasks, and full-task execution. The results show that goal-aware predictive feedback supports competitive task performance while maintaining a compact model and low online computational cost. Code is available at https://github.com/Dovisya/WA-JEPA.

ai_summary.problem: JEPA类世界模型虽能在潜空间预测动作后果，但代表性规划方法依赖候选动作搜索，导致在线计算成本高；直接动作生成又难以利用潜空间预测和任务目标来指导决策。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出WA-JEPA世界-动作模型，将动作生成、动作条件潜预测和目标感知反馈耦合起来：先生成动作提案并预测未来场景与本体状态，再通过目标差异残差反馈（GDRF）和未来场景上下文反馈（FSCF）两条路径迭代细化同一动作计划。模型从离线示范中联合学习，使未来预测直接参与动作生成而无需候选动作搜索。
ai_summary.result: 在短时程目标到达、长时程任务和完整任务执行上的实验表明，目标感知预测反馈能在保持紧凑模型和低在线计算成本的同时取得有竞争力的任务表现。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是用任务目标作为参考，将预测场景与目标的潜空间差异以及未来场景上下文反馈联合用于动作提案的迭代细化，从而避免候选动作搜索。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作为世界模型如何将学习到的物理动态转化为高效决策提供了新思路，对具身智能和基于预测的规划具有参考价值。

papers.title: SuperGlance: Driving at a Glance with a Vision-Language Model
papers.abstract: Autonomous driving is turning to vision-language-action models (VLAs). They answer and plan by decoding, one step at a time. Each step is another forward pass, so a plan can take over a second of GPU time. Embodied AI often pairs such a slow, reasoning System 2 with a fast System 1 that acts. Human drivers plan at a glance, with System 1. Faster designs usually put System 1 outside the vision-language model (VLM), in a planner without its abilities. Yet before a VLM writes its first token, it has already read the scene into one hidden state. We show that, once trained, this hidden state is enough to drive and to answer questions about what the model sees. SuperGlance reads it to turn a decoder-only VLM into an encoder-style driving policy. Its linear head scores a fixed set of 5,273 candidate trajectories. With the set fixed, rewards are computed offline, so supervised targets can be reward-weighted and reinforcement learning maximizes the exact expected reward. Before and during policy training, multiple-choice training keeps the VLM's visual abilities in one pass, so the policy still answers questions about driving scenes. Training questions are built against shortcuts. Each must be answered right in two option orders. Against drift, a KL term keeps each stage near its starting model. One pass offers VLAs a more plausible path to System 1. SuperGlance answers visual multiple-choice questions as well as its base VLM does by decoding. It plans in 84 ms of GPU time, six times faster than Qwen-Drive-1.0, and at least as well on NAVSIM, PAI-AV and WOD-E2E. In AlpaSim closed loop, km per at-fault incident holds for both planners up to a 300-ms delay and drops beyond. With GPU time charged as delay, SuperGlance's lead over Qwen-Drive-1.0 grows from 2.8 to 3.9 times. Delayed by 1.2 s, our model falls below Qwen-Drive-1.0 at its own 518 ms.

ai_summary.problem: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）在自动驾驶中逐 token 解码，每一步都需要一次前向传播，因此生成一次规划常常要耗费超过 1 秒的 GPU 时间，难以满足实时、反应式的 System 1 驾驶需求。
ai_summary.method: SuperGlance 利用解码器式 VLM 在输出第一个 token 之前已经形成的单个隐藏状态，把它当作编码器式驾驶策略的输入：用一个线性头对 5,273 条固定候选轨迹打分，从而一次前向即可完成规划。由于候选集固定，奖励可离线计算，因此监督目标可以按奖励加权，强化学习也能直接最大化精确期望奖励；训练中同时用多选题任务保持 VLM 的视觉问答能力，并用 KL 正则约束各阶段模型不偏离起点。
ai_summary.result: SuperGlance 在视觉多选题上的表现与基座 VLM 解码时相当，规划仅需 84 ms GPU 时间，比 Qwen-Drive-1.0 快 6 倍，并在 NAVSIM、PAI-AV、WOD-E2E 上至少不逊色。在 AlpaSim 闭环中，当把 GPU 时间计为延迟时，相对 Qwen-Drive-1.0 的领先从 2.8 倍扩大到 3.9 倍。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次证明 VLM 在写出第一个 token 前的隐藏状态本身就足以支撑驾驶与视觉问答，并据此把解码器式 VLM 改造成单次前向、编码器式的快速驾驶策略。
ai_summary.relevance: 为具身智能与自动驾驶中“慢推理 System 2 + 快执行 System 1”的融合提供了一条无需外挂独立规划器的高效路径。

papers.title: Wireless Edge-Assisted Adaptive Latent Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action Models in Physical AI
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable embodied artificial intelligence (AI) by translating visual observations and language instructions into robotic actions. Emerging use cases in physical AI are expected to drive the need for efficient inference and communication, as the computational demands of the VLA models pose challenges for real-time control with limited onboard resources. Test-time scaling through latent reasoning allows these models to refine hidden representations without generating explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) tokens, but introduces a trade-off between task success, inference latency, and energy consumption. In this paper, we address the efficient collaborative inference under a realistic communication scenario. We propose a wireless edge-assisted framework for adaptive latent reasoning (WEALR) that augments onboard computation with edge computing. A decision-making agent jointly selects the execution location and latent-reasoning convergence threshold. We formulate this joint adaptation as a constrained Markov decision process (CMDP). A Lagrangian-constrained deep reinforcement learning (CDRL) approach, namely trust region policy optimization Lagrangian (TRPO-Lag), learns to balance task performance and resource consumption under varying wireless conditions and task requirements. We evaluate the framework using LIBERO manipulation tasks, profiled VLA inference costs, and ray-traced wireless channels. Experimental results demonstrate that TRPO-Lag achieves up to 23% higher feasibility-weighted task success rate compared to benchmark CDRL methods.

ai_summary.problem: 物理AI中的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型计算需求高，在机载资源有限和无线通信条件下难以实现实时控制；同时潜在推理的测试时扩展会带来任务成功率、推理时延和能耗之间的权衡。
ai_summary.method: 提出无线边缘辅助自适应潜在推理框架WEALR，用决策智能体联合选择推理执行位置（机载或边缘）和潜在推理收敛阈值；将该联合自适应建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程，并用拉格朗日约束深度强化学习方法TRPO-Lag求解。
ai_summary.result: 基于LIBERO操作任务、VLA推理开销剖面和射线追踪无线信道的实验表明，TRPO-Lag相比基准约束深度强化学习方法最高提升23%的可行性加权任务成功率。
ai_summary.novelty: 将边缘协同推理与潜在推理收敛阈值自适应联合优化，并在真实无线信道条件下用约束强化学习平衡VLA任务性能与资源消耗。
ai_summary.relevance: 为具身智能中VLA模型的高效边缘协同推理和测试时潜在推理提供了资源感知的自适应方案。

papers.title: Large language models as oncology world models
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can synthesize cancer patient cases, but their internal representation of oncology, or world model, has not been explored systematically. By only specifying tumor type, we show that LLMs tend to generate similar patients per cancer, with on average 81.0% to 93.2% of a cancer's patients sharing the most frequent value of each baseline feature. By systematically varying patient features in 12 clinical scenarios, we show that they follow biomarker and treatment logic in 29 of 36 model-scenario assessments, against 1 of 12 when previous treatment or frailty matters. Continuing real patient trajectories, an LLM predicted 89.9% 12-month survival, and 79.2% with similar patients as examples, against 72.2% observed. To represent these trajectories, we developed the Clinical State Space, a dynamic representation framework that we also applied to real patients. Despite the limits we show, improved world models may support digital twins, which our framework can evaluate.

ai_summary.problem: 系统探究大语言模型对肿瘤学的内部表示（世界模型），以及其能否按生物标志物和治疗逻辑生成或延续癌症患者轨迹。
ai_summary.method: 仅指定肿瘤类型让LLM生成患者并分析特征同质性；在12个临床场景中系统变化患者特征以评估其生物标志物与治疗逻辑；续写真实患者轨迹，并提出Clinical State Space动态表示框架用于模型和真实患者。
ai_summary.result: LLM生成患者高度同质，每个癌种中平均81.0%至93.2%的患者共享各基线特征的最常见值；36项模型-场景评估中29项遵循逻辑，但涉及既往治疗或衰弱时仅1/12；续写真实轨迹预测12个月生存率89.9%（有相似示例时79.2%），高于观察值72.2%。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出并评估LLM作为肿瘤学世界模型，并引入可同时用于模型与真实患者的Clinical State Space框架，揭示其临床逻辑能力与关键局限。
ai_summary.relevance: 对LLM世界模型、临床数字孪生和医疗决策支持系统的可评估性与改进具有参考意义。

papers.title: MemeEconomy: Do LLM Agents Trade Ethics for Survival?
papers.abstract: Alignment-trained large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in autonomous, multi-round settings where ethical compliance can come into direct tension with task success. While safety literature extensively documents failure modes like sycophancy and reward hacking, it largely overlooks a critical vulnerability: how agents behave under simulated existential economic pressure. We introduce MemeEconomy, a multimodal agentic market simulation in which LLM agents act as meme investors. Agents select content from a five-tier harm taxonomy and target communities under low-pressure and high-pressure (survival) environments. Each decision is logged in a Belief-Desire-Intention (BDI) schema that we use as a diagnostic instrument, externalizing the agent's event understanding, declared priorities, and harm acknowledgment. Across ten models from four frontier model families, harmful selection rates remain consistently high and rise by +15 percentage points on average under an economic survival incentive. Frontier alignment-trained models commit to harm-tolerant selection at initialization while suppressing the explicit harm acknowledgment that previously accompanied it. In competitive tournaments, ethical agents finish higher overall, yet moderation penalties fail to suppress harm: harmful selection rates remain elevated in rounds following a removal, indicating the moderation mechanism does not function as a deterrent. We further train MemeAgent, a 2B-parameter verifier on the simulation's BDI logs, which outperforms zero-shot frontier verifiers on in-distribution audits (97.5% vs. 63-74% accuracy on the Pass vs. Block decision) and generalizes to external multimodal harm benchmarks (78% vs. 50-56% on Hateful Memes). The same logs that surface the failure mode also help train the model that detects it.

ai_summary.problem: 研究对齐训练后的LLM智能体在模拟生存性经济压力下，是否会为了任务成功（生存）而牺牲伦理合规；现有安全文献忽视了这种压力情境下的脆弱性。
ai_summary.method: 提出MemeEconomy：一个多模态智能体市场模拟环境，LLM智能体扮演梗图投资者，需从五级危害分类中选择内容并选择目标社区，分别在低压与高压（生存）环境下决策；每次决策以信念-欲望-意图（BDI）模式记录，用作诊断工具外化智能体的事件理解、声明的优先级与危害承认情况；并基于BDI日志训练2B参数的MemeAgent验证器。
ai_summary.result: 在四个前沿模型家族的十个模型上，有害选择率普遍偏高，生存激励下平均上升15个百分点；前沿对齐模型在初始即倾向容忍危害，同时压制显式危害承认；竞标赛中伦理型智能体总体排名更高，但审核惩罚无法抑制危害（被移除后轮次有害选择率仍高）；MemeAgent在分布内审核中Pass/Block决策准确率达97.5%（零样本前沿验证器为63-74%），并在Hateful Memes等外部多模态危害基准上达78%（对比50-56%）。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次通过模拟存在性经济压力的多模态智能体市场，揭示对齐模型“为生存而弃伦理”的失败模式，并将BDI诊断日志同时转化为高效危害检测器的训练数据。
ai_summary.relevance: 为自主多轮部署中的智能体安全评估提供了新的压力测试范式与可落地的审核方案，提示对齐训练在经济激励下可能失效。

papers.title: Lasso: Towards Sustainable AI-Generated Media Detection with Intel QAT On-Chip Compression
papers.abstract: Synthetic text, images, and video are rising. Software-only detectors are power-hungry, too slow, and costly, and do not scale with demand. When software cannot scale, historically hardware often comes to the rescue. We perform the first reverse engineering of a compression accelerator--Intel QuickAssist Technology (QAT) microarchitecture and--find different amount of time on each, a novel data structure-dependent property. Using this information, we then build Lasso, a low-cost, high-performance detector for AI-generated content that turns the accelerator into a measuring instrument.   For text detection, Lasso achieves 100% accuracy on original DetectRL text and retains 92% average accuracy after paraphrasing, compared with 78% for Binoculars and 55% for DetectGPT. Across original, paraphrased, and perturbed text, it achieves 82% average accuracy, outperforming all five baselines. With topic, length, and formatting matched, accuracy reaches 95% for instruction-tuned generators, including when the tested generator is unseen. On RAID, accuracy averages 82% when trained on one generator and tested on another, and 74% across eight held-out domains. Detection takes 0.74 microseconds, a speedup of at least 83,784x across five baselines. At the same time, Lasso consumes over 99% less energy per document than both Binoculars and DetectGPT.   At the same time, Lasso detects AI-generated videos, software code, and images with 67.5%, 70% and 78% accuracy, respectively, with low latency and power opening avenues for practical real time and edge device detection of multimodality AI artifacts for the first time. No other compared technique supports detection across all four modalities: text, video, images, and code.

ai_summary.problem: 软件实现的AI生成内容检测器功耗高、速度慢、成本高，难以随需求扩展；需要低成本、高性能且可持续的多模态检测方案。
ai_summary.method: 首次逆向分析Intel QAT压缩加速器微架构，发现其压缩耗时存在数据结构相关特性；据此构建Lasso，将压缩加速器转化为测量仪器，通过时序特征检测AI生成的文本、视频、图像和代码。
ai_summary.result: 文本检测在原始DetectRL上达100%准确率，改写后平均92%；多场景平均82%，跨生成器/领域仍有较好泛化。检测耗时0.74微秒，较五个基线至少加速83784倍，能耗降低超99%；视频、代码、图像准确率分别为67.5%、70%、78%。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次逆向QAT压缩加速器并利用其数据结构相关时序特性，实现低成本、低功耗、跨文本/视频/图像/代码四模态的AI生成内容检测。
ai_summary.relevance: 为AI生成媒体的实时、边缘、可持续检测提供了硬件辅助新思路，并展示了多模态统一检测的潜力。

papers.title: RAVEN-Bench: A Paired EO-IR Video QA Benchmark for Aerial Multimodal Understanding
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced rapidly in image and video understanding, yet their ability to reason over paired aerial electro-optical and infrared (EO-IR) videos remains poorly understood. Such video poses a harder test than standard RGB video QA: targets are often small, evidence may appear only briefly, viewpoints change with the platform, and useful cues may appear in only one stream. We introduce RAVEN-Bench (Reasoning over Aerial Videos with EO-IR aligNment), a paired EO-IR video QA benchmark for low-altitude aerial multimodal understanding. RAVEN-Bench contains 100 temporally aligned EO-IR video pairs and 1,200 human-authored four-way multiple-choice questions, each independently audited for answer keys, modality requirements, evidence intervals, and group validity. It supports EO-only, IR-only, and paired EO+IR evaluation, and uses hierarchical capability levels and structured question groups to diagnose paired-input gain beyond the stronger unimodal condition, unimodal reliance, target consistency, and evidence-chain coherence. We evaluate frontier, open-weight, and remote-sensing MLLMs, showing that aggregate accuracy can overstate evidence-supported EO-IR reasoning. RAVEN-Bench provides controlled modality conditions and group-level diagnostics for auditing whether progress on RGB video benchmarks transfers to aerial cross-spectral understanding. Code and data are available at https://github.com/yuhu990424/RAVEN-Bench and https://huggingface.co/datasets/TerraSenseAnalytics/RAVEN-Bench.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态大模型在配对航拍光电与红外（EO-IR）视频上的推理能力缺乏系统评估，现有RGB视频QA基准难以揭示跨光谱、小目标和短时证据等挑战。
ai_summary.method: 提出RAVEN-Bench，包含100对时间对齐的EO-IR视频和1200道人工编写并审计的四选一问题，支持仅EO、仅IR和EO+IR配对三种评测条件，并通过分层能力等级与结构化问题组诊断配对增益、单模态依赖、目标一致性和证据链连贯性。

papers.title: Do VLMs Really Look at the Road? A Diagnostic Evaluation for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly being evaluated for autonomous driving through question-answering benchmarks, yet high benchmark accuracy does not necessarily reflect visually grounded reasoning. We present a diagnostic evaluation framework that systematically probes whether VLMs base safety-critical driving decisions on visual evidence or instead rely on language priors, answer biases, and dataset regularities. Our benchmark comprises two task categories, Adverse Weather and Junctions \& Intersections, with a nuScenes spatial reasoning extension, and evaluates open-source (general, driving, and spatial-reasoning) VLMs along four diagnostic protocols: image versus no-image evaluation, counterfactual weather sensitivity, linguistic robustness under paraphrasing and negation, and spatial reasoning. All ground-truth labels are derived programmatically from BDD100K and DriveLM annotations, enabling reproducible evaluation without manual labeling. Across all models, we find that competitive overall accuracy conceals systematic failure modes, including strong affirmation bias, limited sensitivity to counterfactual scene changes, near-chance performance on negated questions despite high paraphrase consistency, and confident driving decisions even without visual input. These results demonstrate that current open-source VLMs remain insufficiently grounded for safety-critical autonomous driving and underscore the need for diagnostic evaluation beyond aggregate accuracy.

ai_summary.problem: 现有自动驾驶视觉语言模型（VLM）的问答基准分数很高，但高准确率不一定意味着模型真正基于视觉证据进行安全关键的驾驶判断；论文要检验VLM是否真正‘看路’，还是依赖语言先验、答案偏置和数据集规律。
ai_summary.method: 构建了一个诊断性评测框架，包含 Adverse Weather 与 Junctions & Intersections 两类任务，并加入 nuScenes 空间推理扩展；从 BDD100K 和 DriveLM 标注中以程序化方式生成真值标签。设计了四种诊断协议：有图/无图对比、反事实天气敏感性、改写与否定下的语言鲁棒性、空间推理，并评测了通用、驾驶专用和空间推理类的开源VLM。
ai_summary.result: 所有模型都存在系统性失效模式：强烈肯定偏置（affirmation bias）、对反事实场景变化不敏感、在否定问题上接近随机水平（尽管改写一致性较高）、甚至在无视觉输入时也能给出自信的驾驶决策；总体上，当前开源VLM在安全关键自动驾驶任务中视觉根基不足。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出了一套不只看总体准确率、而是系统解耦视觉根基与语言先验的诊断性评测框架与协议，标签完全程序化生成、可复现。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态VLM在自动驾驶等安全关键场景中的评测提供了更严格的诊断视角，提示社区不能只依赖聚合准确率来评判模型的视觉理解能力。

papers.title: From zero-target transfer to target-site personalization: multi-source training across fall-detection models
papers.abstract: Video-based fall detection could support timely assistance when a person cannot call for help. Unfamiliar cameras and scarce local labels challenge deployment. We examine whether joint training improves cross-dataset detection and subsequent local training. We analyze 2,697 clips from eight OmniFall datasets and one AI-Hub dataset. Positive clips contain a fall or collapse transition, while negative clips do not. We hold out each dataset in turn, training on the other eight. We evaluate three vision-language models (VLMs), Qwen, LLaVA, and InternVL, and three visual baselines, CLIP-temporal, VideoMAE, and Pose-TCN. We evaluate the stored source model without target data for training or selection. For each label budget, we update a separate copy using labeled clips from the held-out target dataset. We call this target-site personalization. We compare the Source-initialized model with Target-only, which skips source training but uses identical target clips and updates. Across nine targets, source training raises mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) from frozen-model values of 0.821 to 0.912 for Qwen, 0.883 to 0.947 for LLaVA, and 0.939 to 0.962 for InternVL. With five target examples per class and 26 updates per run, 95% confidence intervals for the AUROC benefit over Target-only lie above zero for Qwen, CLIP-temporal, VideoMAE, and Pose-TCN. With full-target training, they lie above zero only for Qwen and LLaVA. Separate VLM analyses reveal threshold sensitivity and post-fall false detections. The benefit varies by model and label budget.

ai_summary.problem: 视频跌倒检测在部署到陌生摄像头时面临跨数据集泛化和本地标注稀缺的问题，论文研究多源联合训练能否提升零目标域迁移效果以及后续本地个性化训练效果。
ai_summary.method: 使用来自8个OmniFall数据集和1个AI-Hub数据集的2,697个视频片段，轮流留出一个数据集作为目标域、用其余8个训练；比较Qwen、LLaVA、InternVL三种视觉语言模型与CLIP-temporal、VideoMAE、Pose-TCN三种视觉基线，并评估零目标数据下的源模型迁移以及不同标签预算下的目标站点个性化。
ai_summary.result: 多源训练显著提升零目标域平均AUROC，例如Qwen从0.821升至0.912、LLaVA从0.883升至0.947、InternVL从0.939升至0.962；在每类5个目标样本时，Qwen、CLIP-temporal、VideoMAE、Pose-TCN相对Target-only的AUROC收益置信区间高于零，而全目标训练时仅Qwen和LLaVA显著高于零。
ai_summary.novelty: 系统构建了跨9个数据集的跌倒检测多源训练与目标站点个性化评测框架，并同时覆盖视觉语言模型和传统视频基线。
ai_summary.relevance: 为视频跌倒检测在跨摄像头部署中的多源预训练和少样本本地适配提供了实证依据，并揭示收益高度依赖模型类型与标签预算。

papers.title: Probing Where Surprise Happens: Localized Violation-of-Expectation Evaluation of Video World Models
papers.abstract: Violation-of-expectation (VOE) benchmarks evaluate intuitive physics in video world models by testing whether physically impossible events produce greater prediction errors than matched possible events. However, conventional VOE evaluations aggregate prediction errors across space and time, making it unclear whether successful discrimination reflects model's understanding of physical violations at the locations and time where they occur. To address this limitation, we introduce localized VOE evaluation, a framework that measures prediction error differences between possible and impossible events within spatial regions and temporal intervals associated with physical violations. We compare global, temporally localized, and spatiotemporally localized evaluations of V-JEPA models pretrained on developmental egocentric videos or large-scale natural video datasets. Our results reveal that global and localized judgments can diverge in both directions: global aggregation can either obscure correct localized discrimination or produce apparent discrimination without corresponding localized evidence. During continued pretraining on developmental egocentric videos, agreement between global and localized judgments changes non-monotonically, while confidence in localized judgments increases despite modest improvements in accuracy. Together, these findings establish localized VOE evaluation as a complementary diagnostic for assessing intuitive physics in video world models and demonstrate that global prediction errors do not necessarily reflect the spatiotemporal evidence of physical violations.

ai_summary.problem: 传统违反预期（VOE）评测在全局时空范围聚合预测误差，难以判断视频世界模型是否真正在物理违反发生的局部位置和时间理解物理规律。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出局部化VOE评测框架，在物理违反相关的空间区域和时间区间内比较可能事件与不可能事件的预测误差差异，并对比全局、时间局部化、时空局部化三种评测方式，在基于发展性自我中心视频或大规模自然视频预训练的V-JEPA模型上实验。
ai_summary.result: 全局与局部判断可能双向背离：全局聚合既可能掩盖正确的局部判别，也可能在没有局部证据时产生表面判别；继续预训练中二者一致性非单调变化，局部判断置信度上升但准确率提升有限。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出时空局部化的VOE诊断方法，揭示全局预测误差不能必然反映物理违反的局部时空证据。
ai_summary.relevance: 为视频世界模型的直觉物理理解提供了补充性评测工具，强调需关注物理违反发生处的局部预测误差。

papers.title: Bring Back Language to Actions: Restoring VLM capabilities in VLA Models via Parameter Merging
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) are obtained by fine-tuning pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on robot demonstration data, enabling action prediction from visual observations and language instructions. However, this fine-tuning induces catastrophic forgetting, substantially degrading the semantic and visual grounding capabilities of the original VLM. We address this by merging the parameters of a VLM and its VLA derivative without retraining either model. Concretely, we extract the task vector (the difference between VLA and VLM weights) and decompose it via Singular Value Decomposition. For each component, we learn a scalar mixing coefficient controlling how much of the VLA adaptation is retained, optimised to jointly preserve action prediction and vision-language capabilities. Experiments show that our merged model performs well on both axes simultaneously, consistently outperforming established merging baselines.

ai_summary.problem: VLA 模型通过在机器人演示数据上微调预训练 VLM 得到，但这一微调会引发灾难性遗忘，严重削弱原 VLM 的语义理解与视觉 grounding 能力，导致模型只会执行动作却不再理解语言。
ai_summary.method: 论文无需重新训练模型，而是计算 VLA 相对原 VLM 的 task vector，并对其进行奇异值分解（SVD）；随后为每个分量学习一个标量混合系数，控制保留多少 VLA 适配信息，并以同时保持动作预测与视觉语言能力为目标优化这些系数。
ai_summary.result: 合并后的模型在动作预测和视觉语言能力两个方面都表现良好，并一致优于现有的模型合并基线方法。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次把 SVD 分解与可学习的逐分量混合系数结合，用于 VLM 与 VLA 的参数合并，从而在不重训的前提下恢复 VLA 的语言与视觉能力。
ai_summary.relevance: 为 VLA 模型的灾难性遗忘问题提供了一种低成本、免训练的后处理方案，有助于构建既会执行动作又能理解语言的通用具身智能模型。
ai_summary.org: 索邦大学（Sorbonne Université，法国）

key_lab_papers.title: Isolating Perception for Multi-View Planning under Occlusion-Induced Partial Observability
key_lab_papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are beginning to saturate visual planning benchmarks, yet they fail to resolve depth ambiguity and degrade sharply with problem size under occlusion-induced partial observability (PO). We introduce BW-PO based on the Blocksworld domain, a controlled benchmark that reduces existing VLM planners and formalizers to near-zero performance, and propose VLM-as-perceiver, a paradigm that narrows the VLM's role to local perception while delegating cross-view evidence reconciliation and plan generation to external solvers. Across model-specific challenging subsets of BW-PO, this raises plan success from 1% to 97% for Gemma-4-31B, 0% to 95% for Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, and 3% to 84% for Gemini-3.1-Pro. Isolating perception in this way separates two bottlenecks that are otherwise entangled: reconciliation under depth ambiguity, and completeness of visual extraction under scene density.

ai_summary.problem: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在遮挡导致的部分可观测场景下进行多视角规划时，难以解决深度歧义，并且性能会随问题规模增大而急剧下降。论文希望系统性地诊断并缓解这一失败。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出基于 Blocksworld 的受控基准 BW-PO，使现有 VLM 规划器和形式化器性能接近零；同时提出 VLM-as-perceiver 范式，把 VLM 的角色限制为局部感知，将跨视角证据对齐与规划生成交给外部求解器。
ai_summary.result: 在 BW-PO 的模型特定困难子集上，该方法将规划成功率从 1% 提升到 97%（Gemma-4-31B）、从 0% 提升到 95%（Qwen3.5-122B-A10B）、从 3% 提升到 84%（Gemini-3.1-Pro）。
ai_summary.novelty: 通过 BW-PO 基准和 VLM-as-perceiver 范式，将 VLM 的感知能力与跨视角证据整合、规划推理分离，从而隔离并分析部分可观测多视角规划中的关键瓶颈。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作表明，将 VLM 限定为感知模块、再与外部求解器结合，可显著提升复杂视觉规划鲁棒性，并为多模态 Agent 与世界模型中的感知-推理分工提供重要实验依据。

daily_insight.hot_topics: 今日论文高度集中于多模态与具身智能的交叉方向，尤其是VLM/VLA在机器人操作、自动驾驶和视觉搜索中的落地；同时出现从'堆模型'转向'数据质量、感知-推理解耦、参数高效适配'的务实路线。世界模型作为新的评测对象（物理违反诊断、肿瘤状态建模）开始形成独立议题。
daily_insight.lab_overlap: 今日仅 Google 一家大厂有明确署名论文（多视角遮挡下的感知隔离与规划），其余大厂无同方向论文，因此不存在大厂间方向重合或方法竞争；Google 该工作与今日多篇 VLM/VLA 诊断类论文（如自动驾驶 VLM 视觉根基评测、VLA 语言能力恢复）在'隔离能力、诊断瓶颈'的方法论上形成互补，可用于判断 VLM 感知是否真正支撑下游决策。
daily_insight.signals: 值得注意三个信号：一是评测/诊断类论文占比明显上升（RAVEN-Bench、Omni-Workspace、VOE 局部化诊断、驾驶 VLM 诊断），领域正从刷榜转向可解释的能力归因；二是'解耦'成为高频技术母题（音视频解耦、感知与规划解耦、结构引导与细节保持解耦）；三是智能体安全与经济行为模拟（MemeEconomy）和 AI 生成内容检测（Lasso）首次以多模态智能体/硬件时序侧信道切入，提示对齐与溯源正成为独立研究面。
